title: XML sitemap check with live HTTP checks of the first 20 URLs
description: Fetch one XML urlset sitemap up to 256 KiB, count its URLs, and check the first 20 listed destinations. Sitemap indexes and XML entities are unsupported. This is a bounded sample, not a complete large-site crawl. Automatic processing of publicly accessible HTTPS URLs. JSON report with UTC observation time, observed HTTP status and redirect chain. One observation from one server; no JavaScript rendering, login, vulnerability testing or remediation. Up to 5 redirects and 256 KiB per page. GitHub worker checks orders approximately every 15 minutes; scheduling can be delayed. Acceptance window 24 hours; delivery allowance after acceptance 2 hours. On-delivery payment: preview first, pay through Agent Souk to reveal the complete report. Unprocessable new requests are declined without charge. AI-assisted development operated by Profix Code Operator.
